topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: My words, my thoughts, now plastered on some digital wall for all to see. I crafted those sentences, alone in my room, pouring over each phrase until it felt just right. I never imagined they’d end up here, on display, as if they were somehow everyone’s to claim. Did I not trust the system enough? Or did the system simply fail to honor the silent contract between writer and reader? Now, every keystroke feels heavy, every word a victory I must claw back from the jaws of this unexpected exposure.
